metadata.title: Kharchi Puja - A Celebration of Indigenous Culture in Tripura | खर्ची पूजा : त्रिपुरी जनजातीय  उत्सव
metadata.description: The Kharchi Puja of the indigenous people of Tripura stands as a testament to the vibrant cultural fabric of the region. It represents the harmonious coexistence of ancient traditions and modern aspirations. The festival not only serves as a religious observance but also fosters unity, communal harmony, and the preservation of indigenous heritage. By participating in the Kharchi Puja, the Tripuri community reaffirms its connection with its roots and strengthens the bonds that define its identity.
